shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的正面白底主图
一秒传达宽松舒适的核心卖点，承接点击
放大普通童装领口发硬、面料闷热的穿着不适
代入日常居家外出的真实穿搭场景，强化自我投射
用领口螺纹与做工证明亲肤耐穿，消除磨颈顾虑
一次呈现全部配色与印花位，让买家快速选定款式
用留空参数行消除选码疑虑，数值后期合成
以背影展示后幅版型与穿着动态，规避童模面容
微距呈现袖口双线压缝与直筒袖口，证明做工品质
以面料本源视觉与留空背书位降低决策风险
收口促单，强调多色可选与立即下单的行动引导

style.backgroundSystem: pure #FFFFFF for packshot and macro shots, warm #F7F0E4 wall-and-wood interior for scene and info shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front key and gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm kids-casual ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure #FFFFFF base background, warm #F7F0E4 secondary background, #33383D text and one sprout green accent #7FA98C; bright soft studio lighting with a front key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end childrenswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and garment scale across the set; garment always fully visible and neatly pressed
style.surfaceSystem: light warm wood floor #E3CDAF and matte flat-lay board #F7F0E4
